fields.name: sensitive
fields.label: Is Sensitive
fields.description: Indicates if the field contains sensitive information that should be handled securely.

fields.name: references
fields.label: References
fields.description: Indicates the entity that this field references, if it's a foreign key. Format: 'entityname.fieldname'

fields.name: options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Defines the available options for the field, if it's a select

fields.name: showIf
fields.label: Show If Condition
fields.description: Condition under which the field should be displayed in the UI. Format: { 'sourcefieldname': { 'op': '==', 'value': 'somevalue' } }

fields.name: requiredIf
fields.label: Required If Condition
fields.description: Condition under which the field should be required. Format: { 'sourcefieldname': { 'op': '==', 'value': 'somevalue' } }
